keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: 1–20 phrases, each 1–200 characters. OR search across TED full text. Quotes, backslashes, wildcards and control characters are rejected.

country.title: Buyer country
country.description: Three-letter TED country code (FRA, DEU, ESP…). Empty string or null removes the country filter. Format is validated; code membership is not checked.

days.title: Days
days.description: Publication date >= UTC today minus this many days (inclusive).

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Maximum notices written, newest publication dates first.
